class.name: DisSimulationManagementPdu
class.brief_description: Base class of the Simulation Management PDUs (protocol family 5).
class.description: Simulation Management PDUs let a simulation manager control an exercise. Every PDU of the family starts with the IDs of the originating and the receiving simulation, followed by (except for [DisCommentPdu]) a request ID. The subclasses are [DisCreateEntityPdu], [DisRemoveEntityPdu], [DisStartResumePdu], [DisStopFreezePdu], [DisAcknowledgePdu], and, through [DisDatumPdu], [DisSetDataPdu], [DisDataPdu] and [DisCommentPdu]. The value [constant ID_ALL] (0xFFFF) in a site, application or entity field means "all"; entity number 0 addresses the application itself. [DisExerciseControl] sends and answers these PDUs for you. It has no PDU type of its own and cannot be encoded or decoded; use one of the subclasses.

method.name: is_addressed_to
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member receiving_id] names the application [param application] at site [param site]: its site is [param site] or [constant ID_ALL], and its application is [param application] or [constant ID_ALL]. The entity number is not checked: entity 0, [constant ID_ALL] and a specific entity number all reach the application.

members.member: ID of the sender of the PDU as a [Vector3i] ([code]x[/code] = site, [code]y[/code] = application, [code]z[/code] = entity number).
ID of the intended receiver as a [Vector3i] ([code]x[/code] = site, [code]y[/code] = application, [code]z[/code] = entity number). Each part can be [constant ID_ALL]; see [method is_addressed_to].
Request ID (unsigned 32-bit) chosen by the sender of a request. The matching [DisAcknowledgePdu] repeats it. Not used by [DisCommentPdu], where it stays 0 and is not written.

constants.constant: Value 0xFFFF (65535) in a site, application or entity field of an ID: "all".
